description: Generic lore identity graph for races, lineages, species, sects, tribes, factions, cultivation systems, and regions. Legacy game fields such as sect/race can coexist during migration.

nodeKinds.race: High-level race or realm-wide ancestry group.
nodeKinds.lineage: A sub-race, bloodline, clan lineage, or large species family.
nodeKinds.sect: Sect or school with inherited techniques and organization.
nodeKinds.faction: Loose organization, alliance, valley, palace, market, or political power.
nodeKinds.path: Cultivation system, identity, or technique tradition.
nodeKinds.region: Geographic origin, realm, island sea, forbidden zone, or secret realm.
nodeKinds.spiritRoot: Spirit-root elemental attribute or game root attribute.
nodeKinds.spiritRootLevel: Spirit-root aptitude tier such as heavenly, mutant, true, pseudo, or hidden root.
nodeKinds.constitution: Special body constitution, bloodline body, or acquired body state.
nodeKinds.concept: Reusable lore concept that can support future systems.

edgeRelations.IS_A: Child node belongs under parent node.
edgeRelations.AFFILIATED_WITH: Node is politically or narratively associated with another node.
edgeRelations.SUBORDINATE_TO: Node is under another organization's jurisdiction or hierarchy.
edgeRelations.HAS_CULTIVATION_SYSTEM: Organization or group commonly uses a cultivation system.
edgeRelations.LOCATED_IN: Node is primarily located in a region.
edgeRelations.ORIGINATES_FROM: Node originates from a region or group.
edgeRelations.TEACHES: Organization, lineage, or path teaches a technique, spell, formation, or doctrine.
edgeRelations.OWNS: Hero or group owns an artifact, pet, treasure, or named object.
edgeRelations.USES_ARTIFACT: Hero, group, or path is strongly associated with using an artifact.
edgeRelations.COUNTERS: Node is narratively or mechanically favored against another node.
edgeRelations.SYNERGIZES_WITH: Node has positive gameplay or lore synergy with another node.
edgeRelations.RESTRICTED_TO: Card, artifact, technique, or identity is restricted to a node.
edgeRelations.SOURCE_OF: Node is the source, material, or origin of another node.
edgeRelations.HAS_SPIRIT_ROOT: Hero, character, or group has a spirit-root attribute.
edgeRelations.HAS_SPIRIT_ROOT_LEVEL: Hero or character has a spirit-root aptitude tier.
edgeRelations.HAS_CONSTITUTION: Hero or character has a special body constitution.
edgeRelations.ASSOCIATED_WITH_ATTRIBUTE: Node is associated with an element, attribute, or root.
edgeRelations.IMPROVES: Item or method improves another identity property.
edgeRelations.CONTRADICTS: Source claim conflicts with another curated fact.

nodes.name: 天灵根
nodes.description: 单一五行属性，修炼速度极快，原文称“天根”拥有结丹无瓶颈优势。

nodes.name: 隐灵根
nodes.description: 被特殊体质或血脉遮蔽、间歇显现的稀有灵根，原文以海月天的隐雷灵根作例。

nodes.name: 变异灵根
nodes.description: 二至三种五行属性异变升华，速度不逊天根，但仍有结丹瓶颈。

nodes.name: 真灵根
nodes.description: 两种或三种属性，修炼速度明显优于四、五属性伪灵根。

nodes.name: 伪灵根
nodes.description: 四种或五种属性混杂，修炼困难。韩立原文明确为四属性缺金。

nodes.name: 特殊灵根
nodes.description: 游戏中用于承载阴、血、魔、妖、尸等非标准五行或身份化属性。

nodes.name: 灵根遗传
nodes.description: 原文说明灵根容易出现在相同血脉继承的人身上，支撑修仙家族体系。

nodes.name: 补天丹
nodes.description: 虚天鼎相关丹药，原文说明可弥补灵根不纯、洗炼结丹期修士先天灵根。

nodes.name: 韩立五灵根外部冲突
nodes.description: 灵根网页总结称韩立为五灵根；本地原文明确为四属性缺金，当前以原文为准。

notes: Keep legacy sect/race during staged migration so old deck generation, UI, and validation continue to work.
Use taxonomyRefs for strict graph identity and gameTags for looser deck-building or card synergy.
Non-human groups should not be forced into sect unless the source explicitly treats them as an organization.
